text: Nebraska has won 45 straight games against cupcakes. On the road against ranked teams, it's 0-18: its last one came Nov 12, 2011, 17-14 at No. 12 Penn State.
Hot take: Week 4: we like Jaguars +2.5. The books have Bengals by 2.5; our model has it Jaguars by 2.6. Who's taking the other side? (For fun, not betting advice.)
Utah State is 0-9 at Boise State since at least 2005. Saturday: at No. 22 Boise State.
